about: Palette entries that keep the cartridge colour although bro_groups.json puts them in a picker label. Read by port/tools/gen_vs_char_groups.py, which drops them from every picker row. Tango's Studio labels are not edited; each entry says why it is held back.

keep_cartridge.why: Wario's bare-arm skin: the Studio clustered it with his yellow shirt (auto family torso yellow, renamed Undershirt), so a HAT pick repainted his arms; 16 and 58 are seams on the edge of that skin.
